views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  session,
  stamp,
  path
FROM form_log
WHERE path IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
views.description:
Task: Count the number of distinct sessions that first visited the /regist/input page and then later visited the /regist/confirm page, with the visits occurring in that order for each session.

views.name: chunk_view_0_3
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  al.session,
  al.stamp,
  al.path,
  al.search_type
FROM activity_log al
JOIN (
  -- find earliest '/detail' or '/complete' stamp per session
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(stamp) AS first_detail_complete_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IN ('/detail','/complete')
  GROUP BY session
) first_pc
  ON al.session = first_pc.session
WHERE
  -- only events strictly before the first detail/complete event
  al.stamp < first_pc.first_detail_complete_stamp
  -- only events with non-empty search_type
  AND al.search_type IS NOT NULL
  AND al.search_type <> ''
